args.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(total_cents)/100.0, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(AVG(total_cents)/100.0, 2) AS avg_order, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', ordered_at) IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_orders FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY month

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.ordered_at < '2026-09-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0, 2) AS aug, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)/100.0, 2) AS sep FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sep - aug DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y', incurred_on) AS year, ROUND(AVG(amount_cents)/100.0, 2) AS avg_monthly_butter_dairy FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Butter & dairy' AND strftime('%m', incurred_on) BETWEEN '01' AND '09' GROUP BY year
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', incurred_on) AS month, ROUND(amount_cents/100.0, 2) AS butter_dairy FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Butter & dairy' AND incurred_on >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY month

SELECT strftime('%Y', o.ordered_at) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='Pastry' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents END)/100.0, 2) AS pastry_revenue, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE strftime('%m', o.ordered_at) BETWEEN '04' AND '09' GROUP BY year
SELECT c.email, SUM(o.total_cents) AS spend FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0, 2) AS spend, COUNT(*) AS orders, c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT contact_name, contact_email FROM wholesale_accounts WHERE business_name = 'Bluebird Diner'
